title: Jungle
html:
The Jungle is a region in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It is accessible only through  Akabi at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington. A single party member can be teleported here if they win the jackpot in Akabi's spin the wheel game.

Access

This might be achieved by stealing his  Djinni Ring before playing his game, or (an option for a Bard character) by passing the  DC 20 Perception Check (passive) and then  DC 15 Persuasion Check or  DC 15 Performance Check to distract the djinni while actually playing the game. Only the party member speaking to Akabi will be teleported, and there is no way for other party members to travel there.

Fast travel and long resting are not possible inside of this area. It becomes easier to navigate the Jungle and avoid dinosaurs with characters able to  Fly.

The Jungle appears to be part of the tropical peninsula  Chult, and is full of hostile Alioramus dinosaurs.

Overview

The Jungle is a small area with several alioramus and one alioramus colossa. After being teleported here by Akabi, the only exit is through a portal on the far south-eastern corner. Beside the exit is a DC 20 locked chest containing the legendary weapon  Nyrulna X: -1511 Y: -1522.

West of the entry spot is a alioramus den, with several normal alioramus and one colossal. The dinosaurs do not carry any loot. There are a number of dead bodies with some mid and low tier loot. On a cliff above the den is a skeleton beneath a canvas shelter. Beside them in a backpack is the  Band of the Mystic Scoundrel X: -1566 Y: -1522. The journal  Always Hungry inside the backpack tells the party member where they are now. A note can be found on at a derelict campsite:  Don't Mess With Djinnies.

Once using the portal, the party member will be transported back to one of the outhouses at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington.

If the party member dies while in the Jungle, the glowing orb to revive them will appear near Akabi's stall at the circus.

Related locations

  • ⁠Circus of the Last Days

Creatures

  •  Chult Alioramus - 5x
  •  Chult Alioramus Colossa

Notable loot

  • Band of the Mystic Scoundrel - Near a skeleton above the alioramus den at X: -1566 Y: -1522.
  • Nyrulna - In a locked  Sturdy Painted Chest ( DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check) next to the exit portal at X: -1511 Y: -1522.

Related Literature

  • Don't Mess With Djinnies
  • Always Hungry

Notes

  • There are two corpses in the cave underneath the Skeleton near the magic ring that can be found in the area. Based on the outfits, one may be a reference to Lara Croft (X: 1566 Y: 1503), the other Indiana Jones (X: 1570 Y: 1508).
  • On the far side of the map at X: 1500 Y: 1480 there is another skeleton dressed in a torn full body blue outfit, potentially a reference towards the Vault Dweller or Vault Suits from the Fallout series.
  • A player can permanently softlock themselves by dropping the Netherstones in this region, as there is no known way to retrieve any items dropped in this region (except re-spawning them via mods / 3rd party tools) and it is only possible to visit this region once.
  • An honour mode run can be softlocked if a character has equipped the  Periapt of Wound Closure or is affected by a similar condition and is downed in the Jungle. This results in the character in the Jungle being stuck in an infinite combat loop in a stabilized state. The only known way out of this loop is to kill the downed character by unequipping the necklace and trading them an item that explodes on a timer - namely  Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing Sphere.
